verdict.rationale: Bento documents user-defined automations that run continuously without manual intervention. Users write signals and alert rules in plain English, Bento fires them in real time against traces, judges incidents, and routes them to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook. Trigger-based fixes also ship in shadow mode and graduate to full traffic automatically. These automations are limited to monitoring and remediation of agent traces, not general-purpose background workflows. Missing for 10: general automation beyond trace monitoring and fixes, documentation of scheduling or recurring-job configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Bento trains a signal on your own traces, fires it in real time, and backfills your entire history
Write alerts in English. Bento groups fires into incidents and judges each one real or benign
Rules compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook.
The nudge ships in shadow mode, is scored against the outcome it was meant to fix, and graduates to 100% traffic only if it provably helps.
